words.en: The topography of an area is the physical features of its surface, such as hills, valleys, and rivers, especially the representation of these features on maps.

words.tr:
n. 文件；公文；文献；
v. 记录；为…提供证明；
words.ex: He submitted the document to the office.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件提交给了办公室。
words.en: A document is a piece of text or graphics, for example a letter, that is stored as a file on a computer and that you can access in order to read it or change it.

words.ex: The factory uses a big machine to make cars.
words.ex_cn: 工厂用一台大机器制造汽车。
words.en: A machine is a piece of equipment which uses electricity or an engine in order to do a particular kind of work.

words.ex: The French Revolution changed the government.
words.ex_cn: 法国大革命改变了政府。
words.en: A revolution is a sudden, extreme, or complete change in something, or the act of making such a change.

words.ex: The development of the town took many years.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇的发展花了许多年。
words.en: Development is the process of growth, progress, or making something more advanced.

words.ex: He uses an efficient way to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种高效的方法解决数学问题。
words.en: If something or someone is efficient, they are able to do tasks successfully, without wasting time or energy.

words.tr: n. 印刷术；排印；印刷样式
words.ex: He loves good typography in books.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢书中的好排版。
words.en: The art or process of setting and arranging types and printing from them.

words.ex: Ancient Egypt is one of the oldest civilizations.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及是最早的文明之一。
words.en: A civilization is a human society with its own social organization and culture.

words.tr: n. 摩托雪橇；雪地机动车；
words.ex: He drives a snowmobile across the frozen lake.
words.ex_cn: 他开着摩托雪橇穿越结冰的湖面。
words.en: A snowmobile is a small vehicle, designed for travel on snow and ice, that is steered by skis at the front and propelled by a belt of tracks at the back.

words.ex: He lost all his property in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他在火灾中失去了所有财产。
words.en: Something owned; a possession.

words.ex: The permafrost is melting because of global warming.
words.ex_cn: 永久冻土因全球变暖而融化。
words.en: Permafrost is a thick subsurface layer of soil that remains below freezing point throughout the year, occurring chiefly in polar regions.

words.tr: n. 反复无常；善变；变幻莫测；
words.ex: His capriciousness made it hard to predict his decisions.
words.ex_cn: 他的反复无常让人难以预测他的决定。
words.en: The quality of being given to sudden and unaccountable changes of mood or behavior.

words.tr: adj. 没有受伤的；未受损害的；
words.ex: He walked away from the crash unscathed.
words.ex_cn: 他从车祸中安然无恙地走开了。
words.en: If someone is unscathed after a dangerous experience, they have not been injured or harmed by it.

words.tr: n. 检查；视察；查看；审视；
words.ex: The teacher did an inspection of the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师对教室进行了检查。
words.en: An inspection is an official visit to a building or organization to check that everything is satisfactory and that rules are being obeyed.

words.tr: phrase. 检查报告；检验报告；审查报告
words.ex: The inspector wrote the inspection report after checking the building.
words.ex_cn: 检查员在检查完大楼后写了检查报告。
words.en: A document that records the findings of an inspection.

words.ex: His judgment was clear and fair.
words.ex_cn: 他的判断清晰而公正。
words.en: A judgment is an opinion that you have or express after thinking carefully about something.

words.tr: v. 给...染色；“tint”的现在分词； adj. 带色彩的；
words.ex: She tinted the glass blue.
words.ex_cn: 她把玻璃染成了蓝色。
words.en: If something is tinted, it has a small amount of a particular colour or dye in it.

words.tr: phrase. 着色涂料；带色调的油漆
words.ex: He used tinted paint to make the wall look soft.
words.ex_cn: 他用了有颜色的油漆让墙看起来柔和。
words.en: Paint that has been colored with a tint or pigment, used to add color to surfaces.

words.ex: He wears tinted spectacles to protect his eyes from the sun.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着有色眼镜来保护眼睛免受阳光照射。
words.en: Spectacles with lenses that are colored or darkened to protect the eyes from sunlight or for fashion purposes.

words.tr:
n. 光泽；上光剂；
v. 擦亮；润色；
words.ex: The polish of the wooden table made it shine.
words.ex_cn: 木桌的光泽让它闪闪发亮。
words.en: If you polish something, you make it smooth and shiny by rubbing it with a cloth or a special substance. Polish is also a substance that you use to make things smooth and shiny.

words.tr: adj. 自动化的； v. “automate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The factory uses automated machines to make cars.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂使用自动化机器来制造汽车。
words.en: An automated machine or process is one that operates by itself without needing human control.

words.ex: The company uses automated design to make cars faster.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司使用自动化设计来更快地制造汽车。
words.en: Automated design refers to the process of using computer software and machinery to create designs with minimal human intervention.

words.tr: phrase. 自动化机器；无需人工干预即可执行任务的机械设备
words.ex: The factory uses an automated machine to pack boxes.
words.ex_cn: 工厂使用一台自动化机器来包装箱子。
words.en: A machine capable of operating with minimal human intervention, often programmed to perform specific tasks automatically.

words.tr: adj. 没有瑕疵或污点的；完好无损的；
words.ex: The diamond was unblemished and sparkled brightly.
words.ex_cn: 这颗钻石没有瑕疵，闪闪发亮。
words.en: If something is unblemished, it has no faults or marks and is perfect in every way.
